scope: Controlled hollow leaf geometry through the production detector; native software WebGL fixture. No model or render changes. Not whole-forest alpha-aware coverage.

before.scope: Registered forest near-source rest geometry. Leaf components link by bounding-box proximity, then sampled wood-triangle contacts. Alpha transparency and shader wind are not evaluated; candidates require visual review. Null sampled gap means no nearby triangle was found, not an exact distance.

after.scope: Registered forest near-source rest geometry. Leaf components link by bounding-box proximity, then leaf-surface samples test wood-triangle contacts. Alpha transparency and shader wind are not evaluated; candidates require visual review. Null sampled gap means no nearby triangle was found, not an exact distance.
